title: Annual Sacrifice Art Sale a Success
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder July 22, 2017

The Guild of Harwich Artists, a 501c3 non-profit, held its annual Sacrifice Art Sale on Saturday, July 15 at the Harwich Community Center. A fundraiser for the Guild, artists sold original paintings, prints, cards, books, and art supplies, amounting to close to $2,000. Artists donated half of their proceeds to the Guild to help support our programs and charitable works in the Harwich community. Guild Artists participating were: Chris Banks, Anne Briggs, Dave Crestin, Larry Folding, Barbara Quinn Grasso, Doris Mee, Norma Mutch, Elaine Felos Ostrander, Maryrose Reynolds, June Saline, Colleen SantaLucia, Mary Ann Simpson, Katherine Vacca, and guests, Jane Martin, and Virginia Mead. Kathleen Magnusson was again our photographer of the day.

We thank the community for supporting the Guild of Harwich Artists and extend our appreciation to all Guild members and friends who dropped by!
